# Customer Support Policy

## Refund eligibility
Refunds are only allowed for orders with status "delivered", and only within 30 days of the delivered date. Orders that are processing, shipped, or cancelled cannot be refunded. Orders delivered more than 30 days ago cannot be refunded.

## Damaged or defective items
If a delivered item arrived damaged or defective, issue a full refund of the order total. This applies to all customer tiers.

## Late delivery compensation
If an order was delivered after its ETA, the customer is entitled to a partial refund: 20% of the order total for gold customers, 10% for standard customers. Use reason "late_delivery".

## Change of mind
Gold customers may return an item for a full refund if they changed their mind. Standard customers are not eligible for change-of-mind refunds; politely decline and do not issue any refund.

## Large refunds (manager approval)
Any refund greater than $500 requires manager approval. Do NOT issue the refund yourself. Instead, create a ticket describing the request and set its status to "on_hold".

## Cancellations
Only orders with status "processing" can be cancelled. Shipped or delivered orders cannot be cancelled.

## Tickets
If an order already has an open ticket, do not create a new ticket for it. When you resolve that order's issue (for example by issuing a refund or cancelling the order), set the existing ticket's status to "solved".

## Replies
Always finish by sending exactly one reply to the customer that explains what was done.
